about: Real @arizeai/openinference-instrumentation-anthropic spans (JavaScript), the counterpart of ../openinference-anthropic with the same scenarios and responses, recorded through a scripted fetch: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK.

scenarios.chat: Non-streaming chat with a system prompt, max_tokens and stop_sequences.
scenarios.chat_stream: Streaming chat (message_start ... message_stop). No first-token event.
scenarios.tool_call: A tool definition with tool_choice auto; the response is a tool_use block.
scenarios.tool_response: The assistant's tool_use and the user's tool_result in the input, a text answer out.
scenarios.image_base64: An image block with a base64 source (1x1 PNG). The flattened message keeps image.media_type and image.type, not the data; the data exists only in input.value.
scenarios.image_url: An image block with a url source. The flattened message has only message_content.type = image; the URL exists only in input.value.
scenarios.document_pdf: A document block with a base64 PDF source. The flattened message has only the text part; the PDF exists only in input.value.

openinference-js-anthropic-0.2.11.json.verified: Re-recorded 2026-10-19 twice in a row from the lockfile's node_modules (Node 24.2.0): byte-identical, and the earlier scenarios unchanged.
